claims.statement: The Northgate Business Park lease premises consist of approximately 92,000 rentable square feet, located in Building A, Suites 100–450, along with 220 surface parking spaces and non‑exclusive use of the shared loading area.

citations.quote: The premises consist of approximately 92,000 rentable square feet across Building A, Suites 100–450, together with 220 surface parking spaces and non-exclusive use of the shared loading area on the east side of the property.

claims.statement: This 92,000 SF figure is consistent with the tenant covenant disclosure that the anchor tenant leases 62% of the property's net rentable area, since the comparable-set data lists the overall building area for Northgate Business Park at 148,500 square feet, and 92,000 SF is approximately 62% of that total.

citations.quote: The anchor tenant, Vantage Fulfillment Co., leases 62% of the net rentable area
